objects.A: equivariant exact feasible relation A(x) subseteq Y with A(g.x)=g.A(x)
objects.Fix_Y(H_x): {y in Y: h.y=y for all h in H_x}
objects.G: finite group acting exactly on typed input/context space X and candidate output space Y

selector_scope: deterministic G-equivariant selection on one G-orbit at a time
universalization_boundary: No theorem is promoted beyond the declared finite-group equivariant selector calculus.
